answer: An operator running 196 keys therefore pays for 196 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the violet salt is published after the hollow checkpoint, the yarrow audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 133 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
